user_outcome: Agents can identify the validated context source and preserve whether Gnomon applied, rejected, scenario-retained, or found no distinct numeric path; humans see the same evidence and authority limits without opening an internal artifact.

original_preregistered_result.detail: Three of eight final-code rows changed from rejected to nonnumeric scenario_only after the compiler type repair. This is not reported as a preregistered pass.

revised_subiteration_result.reason: The only engine changes are the expected safe demotions of unsupported numeric authority; forecasts, sMAPE, application, primary, automation, parity, and leakage remain exact, and final agent preservation passes.

promoted_changes: validated event provenance reaches context outcomes, sealed publication dispositions, compact execution state, and final source projections
unsupported numeric event namespaces are demoted only when no non-temporal number remains; unparsed numeric claims still fail closed
admitted future covariates publish their typed relationship to the primary and evidence automation authority
agent answers must affirmatively preserve applied/admitted context and covariate state
repeated identical provenance is grouped in compact briefs with exact counts, one exact representative, and the sealed receipt location
sandbox-root reload tests restore their original environment before reloading, eliminating suite-order contamination
remaining_risks: The naturalistic corpus is synthetic prose and does not prove real organizations provide useful, timely source documents at the same rate.
Structured inline covariates carry known_at but no source.reference; source provenance cannot be projected when the caller did not supply one.
The eight-case current-code smoke is a regression shard, not a new public accuracy claim.
Repeated-event admission remains conservative and can stay scenario-only when fold stability is insufficient.
